topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Rain falls like tiny knives outside my window. Another soul's dreams slain by the letter of the law. This young inventor, eyes bright with the sheen of a hundred late nights, walks in, drops a file on my desk. His gadget—a marvel, he swears. But the papers tell a different story. Patented clean across the board by a company with more lawyers than he has patents. Cheap talk won't bring those dreams back to life. Not much I can do, but I'll poke around. Maybe, just maybe, there's a crack in their fortress. The rain keeps on, each drop a tick of the clock against his dwindling hope.
